_comment: Default knobs for workload/. A scenario config (e.g. agentx_glm52.json) layers on top of this, and command-line --set layers on top of that. Every path is either absolute or resolved relative to the GEAK repository root.

target._comment: What this run optimizes. A scenario config MUST fill in `model`: scripts/target.py refuses to start a run whose config filename or run_root does not carry a recognisable token of it, and cross-checks `image`/`commits` against what the stages observed and recorded. This exists because a run once carried a planning-phase label (`agentx_dsv4`) for a GLM-5.2 stack from end to end -- every number was right and every label was wrong. `name_tokens` whitelists a deliberate abbreviation the tokeniser cannot derive (e.g. "dsv4" for DeepSeek-V4). Set `enforce` to false only with a written reason.

params.selection: per-phase Top 5 AND overall GPU-time share > 3%

runner_env._comment: state_dir_base must sit on local disk, never on NFS (the agent's sqlite gets poisoned there). env_file points at a credential/gateway file kept **outside the repo**; see runners/claude.env.example for the template — keys are never committed. Leaving model null uses the CLI's own default rather than inheriting an ANTHROPIC_MODEL that may already be exported in the environment.
